currentParagraphText: “Don’t get me wrong, what I’m talking about isn’t easy nor natural to most people,” Artemis said. “Your current understanding, even for those who grew up with the system, is the most intuitive. The most powerful arrows of an archer do tend to also be the fastest as they simply have a lot more energy infused into them. Additionally, if you use a powerful skill, trying to change the balance gets magnitudes harder.”
